tei:div.tei:p: (1) ༄༅// sarba to ding+mahā bi dza ya mañdzu nā tho bhū mī pāṇ+ḍ+raḥpaṇ+ḍi tā nan+da dhā dza sha shrī bha dra pā da s+ya pra wa tsa naṃ pusta ko dwi tī yā bh+yaṃ pra mā ṇa yuk+ta ni dhi rnā ma shā s+t+ra bi ha ra ti sma// ༄༅// phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi gsung rab glegs bam gnyis pa las tshad ma rigs pa'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ pra mā ṇa yug ta ni dhi/ bod skad du/ tshad ma rigs pa'i gter/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa// 'gro kun dge legs sgrub pa'i thugs rje can// bsam yas phrin las mdzad pa'i stobs mnga' ba// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// blo gros spyi gtsug yon tan nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras// bden gnyis ro 'dzin stong nyid phud sgra'i sgra sgrogs shing*// mkhyen brtse'i lta zer phas rgol skye bos mi bzod pa// blo gsal rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur dpal ldan klu dbang rgyal// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas pa'i rgyu skar bye ba brgyas// dpal ldan grags pa'i gsung rab pad+mo kha phye mod// gang blo'i nyi 'od snang bas ma khyab de srid du// gzhung lugs dgongs don ge sar snying po gsal ma nus// chos kyi grags pa'i bzhed gzhung ji lta bar// blo gros gsal ba'i mig gis legs mthong nas// shes ldan gzu bor gnas pa don gnyer ba// gzhan la brtse ba'i bsam pas 'di bshad do// yul gyi mtshan nyid blos rig bya// don spyi dang ni med snang gnyis// yul yin zhe na de 'dzin gyi// shes pa gnyis po 'khrul par 'gal// yul yod na yang thag pa la// sbrul 'dzin bzhin du 'khrul zhe na// khrar 'dzin yul yod phyir ma 'khrul/ yul med pas na sbrul 'dzin 'khrul// snang yul gnyis po shes pa las// tha dad yin na yul rung bar// gnas pa'i gang zag gzhan gyis kyang*// mthong 'gyur bum pa la sogs bzhin// don nyid yin yang lus kyi nang*//

(2) mi mthong bzhin du 'khrul snang gnyis// bdag la rtag tu 'brel pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi rtogs pa med ce na// nang gi lus ni yul rung min// des na rang gis kyang mi mthong*// rang dang rtag tu 'brel pas na// gnyis po'ang yul rung min zhe na// rang blo kho na dang 'brel phyir// brjod kyang gzhan gyis rtogs mi 'gyur// rang rang blo dang 'brel pa'i phyir// brjod pas de nyid rtogs she na// gang zag gnyis kyi brjod bya'i don// so so yin phyir sbyor mi nus// gang zag so so la yod pa'i// sems kyi rnam pa gnyis 'dra bas// 'dra ba gcig tu zhen pa la// tha snyad sbyor phyir mi 'gal na// rang la shar na rang yul yin// ma shar na ni de yul min// des na tha dad gzung ba la// gcig tu 'dzin pa ga la srid// tha dad yin yang yul gcig tu// 'khrul pa'i sgo nas 'dzin zhe na// gcig tu 'dzin pa 'khrul pa'i phyir// gzung yul med par grub pa yin// rigs pas brtags na med bzhin du// da dung phal cher yul du zhen// sor mo'i rtse mos bstan pa na// nam mkha' mthong zhes blun po 'khrul// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// gzhal bya rang mtshan gcig kho na// yul gnyis bzhed pas gnod ce na// 'jug tshul sgo nas rang spyi gnyis// med pa'ang gzhal byar mtshungs she na// de la yul gyi dgos nus med// skra sogs snang ba blo nyid yin// skrar snang don la grub pa med// de ni dngos por yod med ces// rtog pas dpyod na spyi mtshan yin// dngos med (3) gnyis po rang rig gi /shugs la grub pas bsal zhe na// 'khrul shes gnyis la yul med cing*// rang rig gis ni myong ba'i phyir// shes pa nyid yin de yang ni// med pa 'dzin phyir 'khrul shes yin// rang mtshan min pa'i yul med na/ dngos med gzhal byar 'gal zhe na// dgag bya dngos por yod med ces// grub pa'i phyir na 'gal ba med// phyi yi gzung yul mkhas pas bkag

/shes pa'i gzung yul 'dir mi srid// des na gzhal bya gcig nyid kyang*// mi 'thad ces ni 'ga' zhig smra// ngo bo nyid dang dbang phyug dang*// gtso bo rdul dang rnam rig dang*// rten 'brel yin zhes grub pa'i mtha'// tha dad rang gzhan sde pa 'dod// chod pa min phyir rnam shes min// dbang po rten bcas lta byed lo// bem po yin phyir lta byed min// dus mnyam pa la 'brel pa med// yul dang rnam shes dus mnyam ni// gzung 'dzin yin zhes gangs can pa// dus mnyam phyir na 'brel pa med// rgyu med pa la rnam shes 'gal// skad cig snga ma'i yul rgyu yin// dus mnyam gzung yul yin zhe na// yul las skyes phyir rnam shes grub// de la dus mnyam dgos pa med// yul dang dbang po yid la byed// de las skyes pa rnam shes yin// zas sogs bu yi rgyu yin yang*// pha ma'i gzugs bzhin yul 'drar skye// des na yul la 'bras bu gnyis// blo yang tshul gnyis yin par 'dod// gcig dang du ma bral ba'i phyir// don med des na rnam pa'ang med// kun rdzob 'jig rten grags pa la// brten na tshad ma'i rnam gzhag 'gal// gsal dang lhan cig dmigs (4) pas 'grub// lhan cig dmigs la gzhan mi srid// rdzas gzhan yin na rtags mi srid// zla gnyis snang bzhin sngo 'dzin yang*// gzhan la mtha' gzhan bkag pas khegs// sems rgyun yan lag can dang mtshungs// skad cig rdul gyi cha shas bzhin// des na skad cig gsum bdag phyir// gcig dang du ma bral zhes zer// skad cig gsum gyi bdag nyid phyir// skad cig gcig pa mi srid 'gyur// skad cig gcig pa mi srid na// gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa nyams// rags pa cig char bskor bas na// dbus kyi rdul phran cha bcas 'gyur// dus gsum cig char mi skye bas// da lta'i skad cig cha med yin// don du snang ba blo nyid yin// snang ba de nyid phyi na med// bag chags brtan dang mi brtan las// bden dang brdzun pa'i rnam gzhag byed// ji srid phyi rol khas len pa// de srid rgyu la gzung yul zer// shes bya nang gir zhugs pa na// yul dang yul can grub pa med// bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las yul brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o//

༈ //blo yi mtshan nyid rig pa yin// yul sogs sgo nas du mar 'gyur// shes pa'i sgo nas rang rig gcig /yid dpyod snang la ma nges dang*// bcad shes log shes the tshom lnga// yid dpyod rtags la gtan mi ltos// dam bca' tsam yin the tshom 'gyur// rtags la ltos na yang dag gam// ltar snang gsum las 'da' ba med// rgyu mtshan can gyi yid dpyod gnyis// ltar snang gsum du mi 'du na// gtan tshigs ltar snang (5) bzhi par 'gyur// yid dpyod ltar snang ma yin na// tshad ma gsum pa srid par 'gyur// bden pa nges kyang tshad min na// rjes su dpag pa'ang min par 'gyur// nges kyang sgro 'dogs mi gcod na// gnod bya gnod byed min par 'gyur// nges pa med kyang bden brdzun dang*// som nyi'i blo gsum mi 'gal na// nges pa med na yid dpyod nyams// gnyis su 'gyur na the tshom dka'// yang na bden pa'i yid dpyod ltar// log pa'i yid dpyod cis mi 'thad// 'dod na yid dpyod bden pa nyams// min na snga ma'ang min par mtshungs// gnyis kar dogs na the tshom 'gyur// gal te srid na grangs nges 'jig /log shes yin na yid dpyod kyang*// tshad ma nyid 'gyur mtshungs phyir ro// gal te rgyu mtshan med pa yi// yid dpyod bden na kun bden 'gyur// gal te log pa'i rgyu mtshan can// yid dpyod yin na gzhung dang 'gal// rang gzhan sde pa'i lung las rtogs// blo rigs bzhir 'dus yid dpyod min// gal te snang la ma nges pa// tshad ma min na mngon sum kun// tshad mar min 'gyur mngon sum la// nges pa nyid ni bkag phyir ro/ bcad shes rigs pas mtha' bcad na// ma rtogs pa dang log rtog dang*// yang na tshad ma nyid 'gyur gyi// de las gzhan pa'i blo mi srid// mngon sum rtog bral da ltar ba// bcad shes 'das pa dran pa yin// yul dus 'dzin stangs 'gal ba la// gzhi mthun pa ni ga la srid// rigs rgyun 'dzin pa mngon sum ste/

rjes shes bcad shes yin zhe na// rigs (6) ni mngon sum yul ma yin// mthong ba'i don la rjes shes med// 'gal ba'i phyir na gzhi mthun med// mngon sum yin phyir dran pa min// rigs ni dbang po'i yul du 'gal// mthong ba snga phyi khyad par med// nges pa yod na mngon sum min// 'dra bar 'dzin pa rtog pa yin// des na mngon sum bcad shes dang*// gzhi mthun rigs pa shes pas bkag /ces bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// yul dang dbang po'i rdul phra rab// tshogs pa'i skad cig ji snyed kyis// myong ba'i rnam shes gang bskyed pa// so so skye bo'i mngon sum yin// grangs kyi dbye bsdu ji snyed pa// rigs kyi dbye bas byas pa yin// nang gi dbye bsdu ji snyed pa// de yi khongs su gtogs par bzhed// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// mi bslu ma grub tshad ma min// ma rtogs log rtog the tshom ste// tshad ma'i 'gal zla rnam pa gsum// 'jug tshul sgo nas phye ba yin// ngo bo'i sgo nas bsdu na gcig /de dang de min 'dzin pas stong*// ma rtogs pa yin dbye na gsum// ma zhugs pa dang ma rdzogs dang*// rdzogs par gyur kyang ma rnyed pa'o// de 'dzin pa la de min gyis// gnod pa log shes dbye na gnyis// rtog pa dang ni rtog med de// so sor phye na rnam pa lnga// de 'dzin na yang de min srid// the tshom nyid yin dbye na gnyis// mngon du gyur dang bag la nyal// cha mnyam pa dang shas cher 'dzin// tshad ma'i shes pa gnyis po yang*// rang rig (7) tshad ma kho nar 'dus// tshad ma min pa gsum po yang*// ma rtogs pa las don gzhan min// zhes bya ba bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las blo brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //rang mtshan 'dzin pa rtog med de// spyi 'dzin pa ni rtog pa yin// de la rang mtshan dngos po ste// spyi ni dngos por grub pa med// rdzas dang ldog pa spyi bye brag

/sgrub dang gzhan sel rtog mi rtog /gzhan dag rnam gzhag gzhan du 'chad// kho bo gzhung bzhin 'chad par 'dod// rjes dpag dngos por mi 'dzin pas// de la rdzas chos 'thad ma yin// sel ba yin phyir rjes dpag ni// ldog pa'i sgo nas grub par bzhed// gzhan dang rang gi dngos po las// ldog par byed pa spyi bye brag /thad ka dang ni gong ma yi// spyi dang bye brag gnyis gnyis yod// thad ka'i bye brag rdzas tha dad// gong ma'i bye brag gcig pa bkag /kha cig tha dad yin zhes zer// tha dad snang rung med pas khegs// kha cig rdzas gcig yin zhes zer// rdzas gcig na yang snang rung min// yul dus rnam pa 'gal ba yi// bye brag spyi gcig dang 'brel na// skye 'jig ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur// min na gcig la cha gnyis 'gal// spyi dang bye brag rdzas gcig na// yan lag can yang ji ltar dgag /dbang po'ang rtog bcas nyid du thal// 'gal ba kun kyang rdzas gcig 'gyur// bye brag re re dang 'brel pa'i// spyi yang du ma yod ce na// mtshan nyid mi 'grub dgag sgrub kyi// rnam par gzhag pa'ang 'jig par 'gyur// (8) mtshan nyid mtshungs pa'i spyi gcig dang*// bye brag rdzas gcig yin no lo// mtshungs pa rtog pas sbyar ba yin// rtog pa'i blo chos don la med// don la 'dra ba yod na ni// sngon med mthong na'ang 'dra bar 'gyur// mtshungs la dngos po gcig mi srid// gcig ma yin la spyi sgra med// blo la spyi gcig ma shar na// mtshungs par rtogs kyang spyir mi rung*// phyogs re 'dra ba kun la yod// thams cad 'dra ba gang na'ang med// rigs pa'i rgyal pos gsungs pa yi// rnam gzhag dang yang 'gal bar snang*// de min rang bzhin las ldog pa// dngos po kun la grub pa de// sel ba'i spyi yin rang mtshan du// 'khrul pa de la dgag sgrub byed// gal te don la spyi med na// gzhan sel sgro btags dngos med la// grub kyang don dang ma 'brel phyir// tha snyad thams cad 'jig ce na// don dang sel ba gcig nyid du// 'khrul nas yul la 'jug pa na// rang gi mtshan nyid thob pa tsam// tshad ma yin phyir 'thad pa yin// tha dad spyi 'dod 'ug phrug pa// rdzas gcig yin zhes grangs can pa// gangs can pa rnams de rjes 'brang*// sel bar 'dod pa mkhas pa'i lugs// bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las spyi dang bye brag brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gsum pa'o//

༈ //rtog med snang ba'i sgo nas 'jug /sgra rtog thams cad gzhan sel yin// de dag 'khrul dang ma 'khrul pa'i// dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bzhi// don la gnas pa'i dngos po rnams// gcig la du ma mi srid cing*// du ma gcig tu gnas mi srid// gcig la gsal dang (9) mi gsal med// mngon sum thams cad don bzhin snang*// gcig la tha dad snang ba med// tha dad gcig tu snang mi srid// snang bas 'jug la res 'jog med// yul la ji ltar gnas pa yi// stobs kyis dbang shes skyes pas na// med na mi 'byung nges pa'i phyir// blo don phan tshun 'chol ba med// des na mngon sum tshad ma yang*// rtog med yin phyir nges mi dgos// mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul ba// nyid kyis tshad ma grub pa yin// de 'am gzhan gyi stobs nyid las// nges pa'i dbang gis dgag sgrub byed// sngon po'i ldog pa nges pa ni// rtog pa yin phyir gzhan sel yin// 'khrul nas 'jug yul rang mtshan thob// nang du rang rig tshad mar 'dod// gang la nges pa yod pa des// sgro 'dogs gcod par shes par bya// nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs yid// gnyis ka sel bas 'jug pa'i phyir// de dag mngon sum ma yin zhes// rigs pa mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin// sgra rtog snang bas 'jal na ni// dgag sgrub cig char rtogs par 'gyur// gcig la du mar btags na yang*// rnam grangs yin gyi tha dad min// ldog pas 'byed na sel ba la// dngos po'i ming gis btags par zad// de la snang bar rlom pa 'khrul// dngos 'gal bcad nas 'jug pa ni// gzhan sel yul can yin par bzhed// brtags phyir sel ba dngos yul med// 'khrul pa'i 'jug yul rang mtshan yin// rang mtshan gcig dang tha dad la// sel ba'i 'dzin stangs mu bzhi srid// bya dang mtshan nyid gcig pa la// bag chags stobs kyis gcig tu 'khrul// tha dad mtshungs la 'bras bu'i (10)

blo// gcig dang tha dad 'gal zhe na// rnam shes dang ni sman bzhin du// tha dad yin yang khyad par yod// tha dad rnams la dgag sgrub kyi// bya ba phyogs gcig rtogs par 'gyur// gzhan sel spyod yul tha dad pas// gcig la'ang ldog pa tha dad rung*// sgra dang rtog pa'i 'jug tshul ltar// don la tha dad nyid du zhen// gcig la gcig tu ma gtogs (rtogs )pa// rtogs par bya phyir rnam par dbye// yod dang med par 'dzin pa yi// sgo nas gzhan sel rnam pa gnyis// sgra dang blo yi dbye ba yis// yod med de yang gnyis gnyis yin// gzhan sel blo yi 'jug tshul yin// bem po'i don la gzhan sel med// don gyi gzhan sel rang mtshan phyir// snang yul 'gyur gyi sel ba nyams// snang ba'ang don la yod par mtshungs// 'dod na long ba rgyun chad 'gyur// dngos po'i gzhan sel dngos med gcod// snang ba dang ni mi snang ba// yul gyi sgo nas dbye na gnyis// rang gi mtshan nyid snang ba la// rjes kyi nges shes ji snyed pa// sgra dang rtog pas phye bas na// sel ba cha yi yul du 'gyur// rang gi mtshan nyid mi snang ba// rtags la ltos pa'am ma ltos kyang*// sgra dang rtog pa'i yul yin pas// nges pa de yang gzhan sel yin// bden dang mi bden mtha' gnyis pa// rtog pa'i 'jug tshul rnam pa gsum// med pa gzhan sel yod pa gcod// dgag bya yod dang med pa yi// sgo nas sel ba rnam pa gnyis// dngos med ngo bo yod min pas// ngo bo med pas shes bya min// des na dngos po bsal ba la// dngos med ces ni btags par zad// dngos po rgyu las grub pa ni// dngos po med la ltos mi dgos// dngos med rgyu yis ma bskyed pas// dngos po

(11) bkag nas blo ngor sgrub// ri bong rwa sogs med mod kyi// 'dus ma byas dang 'khrul yul gnyis// der snang ba yi stobs nyid las// de yul yod par grub ce na// der snang ba de shes pa yin// phyir 'dod tshad mas gzhal mi nus// des na 'dus ma byas gsum dang*// 'khrul yul gnyis la tshad ma med// nam mkha' med na 'jig rten dang*// bstan bcos gnyis dang 'gal zhe na// rang mtshan med phyir mngon sum min// 'brel pa med phyir rjes dpag med// des na nam mkha' yod do zhes// sgrub par byed la tshad ma med// sngon por snang ba kha dog yin// bu ga gzugs ma mthong ba yin// des na rgyan dang bu ga yi// nam mkha' nam mkha'i sgrub byed min// 'dus ma byas rnams ma grub na// rtag par bshad pa 'gal zhe na// mu stegs byed dang nyan thos kyi// rtag smra gnyis po rtag par 'dod// chos kyi grags pas mi rtag pa// log la rtag pa'i tha snyad 'dogs// dbang shes lkugs pa mig can 'dra// rtog pa long ba smra mkhas 'dra// rang rig dbang po tshang ba yis// gnyis po de yi brda sprod byed// ces bya ba bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //spyi med phyir na de yi sgra// rgyu med can du 'gyur zhe na// brjod 'dod dbang gis 'jug pa'i phyir// sgra rnams yul la ltos pa med// de lta yin na chos chos can// brjod pa don med 'gyur zhe na// don gyi ngo bo gcig nyid la// brjod 'dod stobs kyis sgra gnyis sbyar// dngos 'gal gcod pa gzhan sel sgra// de ni phan tshun brten pa'i phyir// (12) gcig ma grub pas gnyis ka med// des na gzhan sel mi srid lo// khyed kyang dngos 'gal mi gcod na// de yi ngo bo rtogs mi srid// gcod na 'gal zla ma rtogs pas// tha snyad thams cad med par 'gyur// dngos 'gal bsal nas dngos po de// mi sgrub 'on kyang gcig mthong bas// de la brda byed tha snyad kyi// dus na'ang de nyid rtogs she na// brda yi dus na shing ma yin// ma bkag na ni shing mi 'grub// gal te bkag na shing 'grub mod// 'on kyang de ni gzhan sel yin// yal ga lo ma ldan mthong nas// de la shing gi brda byed pas// brda de rigs la sbyor bar byed// rigs ni gzhan sel las gzhan min// gzhan las bzlog nas der 'jug phyir// tshig kun nges gzung snying po can// shes bya sogs sgra gcad bya med// de la rnam gcad 'gal zhe na// de las gzhan dngos med na yang*// btags pa'i sgo nas rnam gcad yod// gal te khyed kyi ldog pa de// dngos po yin na spyi dang mtshungs// dngos med yin na dgos nus med// des na ldog pa mi dgos lo// 'di la bod rnams phal cher ni// dngos po'i ldog pa dngos por 'dod// de lta yin na spyi yi skyon// brjod pa 'di ni gdon pa dka'// shing min las ldog dngos po de// sha pa yin na gzhan shing min// gzhan shing yin na sha pa min// de yi rang bzhin gzhan min phyir// chos kyi grags pa'i gzhung bzung nas// bdag nyid chen po'i rigs pa 'gog

/nags la gnas pa'i spre 'u dag /ljon pa'i shing la mi gtsang 'thor// zhes bya ba bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// (13) ldog pa dngos por ma grub cing*// blo yi 'jug tshul dpyad pa na// dngos po kun la yod pa'i phyir// gzhan sel la ni skyon 'di med// des na sgra gcig brjod na yang*// dgag sgrub nus pa rnam gnyis yod// chos gnyis gcig pa mi srid cing*// ldog pa ngo bo ma grub pas// ldog pa brjod pa nyid kyis na// ldog pa'i dngos po grub par gsungs// tha dad rnams la spyi med na// ut+pal sngon po la sogs pa// chos rnams gcig la mi 'du bas// gzhi mthun med par 'gyur zhe na// sngo las ut+pal gzhan min yang*// sel ba'i dbye bsdus rtog pa'i ngor// gzhi mthun nyid 'gyur rang mtshan la// 'jug phyir dbang po'i spyod yul min// sgrub dang gzhan sel rnam dag gi /mig dang blo gros gsal ldan pa// rtog ge pa de shes bya yi// de nyid lta ba kun mkhyen 'dra// zhes bya ba bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las sgrub pa dang gzhan sel brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ //bum pa la sogs don rang mtshan// brjod bya yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra// rang mtshan so sor nges pa ni// mtha' yas phyir na brda mi nus// tha snyad byed pa'i tshe na yang*// dang po'i rang mtshan rnyed par dka'// 'das dang ma 'ongs brjod bya min// de la rang mtshan med phyir ro// sgra yi rang mtshan nyid brjod na// mig dbang la sogs dgos med 'gyur// don la 'brel pa med pa'i phyir// dbang pos 'brel pa 'dzin mi srid// de yis 'di zhes sbrel ba ni// dpyod pa yin phyir gzhan sel (14) yin// dang po 'brel pa byed pa'i tshe// rang gi mtshan nyid bstan na yang*// brda ni spyi la sbyor byed de// tha snyad don du 'dogs phyir ro// dbang pos sgra dang 'dres pa'i don// 'dzin na brda med kyang rtogs 'gyur// dbang po'i sgo la rjes 'brangs yid// mthong sbyor 'dres pa rtog med 'dra// gzhan du mthong rtog yul tha dad// yin phyir don rtogs mi srid lo// rtog bcas rtog pa med pa'i yid// 'jug yul gcig la cig char 'jug

/rim gyis 'jug kyang myur ba la// blun po rnams kyis gcig tu zhen// shes pa rang gi mtshan nyid yin/ des na de la brdar mi rung*// sgra yis gsal bar mi brjod kyi// rigs spyi brjod phyir skyon med na// don la spyi med yod na yang*// de la sbyar ba dgos nus med// spyi dang 'brel pa'i rang mtshan la// sbyar bas rang mtshan go zhe na// dgos nus med pa'i spyi bor la// rang gi mtshan nyid dngos la sbyor// gal te rang mtshan mtha' yas phyir// mi nus she na 'di la'ang mtshungs// gangs can pa dang nyan thos gnyis// sgra don dngos kyi brjod byar 'dod// mi ldan 'du byed la sbyar bas// 'brel med gzugs la ji ltar rtogs// bum pa zhes ni brjod pa las// 'brel med ba lang mi rtogs bzhin// 'brel pa med kyang 'dra ba la// 'khrul nas don la 'jug ce na// 'dra bas 'khrul na yul dang dus// res 'ga' 'khrul gyis kun tu min// 'di ni rtag tu 'khrul 'gyur bas// 'dra ba'i sgo nas 'khrul pa min// brda las go bya go byed yin// 'chad dang 'jug pa'i gang zag gi /dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bzhi// (15) 'chad tshe rnam par phye bas mkhas// 'jug tshe gcig tu 'khrul pas thob// don dang shes pa rang mtshan yin// spyi 'dod gnyis po med pa yin// de bzhi brjod bya ma yin pas// dam pa'i don du brjod bya med// rtog pa ngo bos 'khrul pa la// sgra yi don gyi gzugs brnyan shar// de la phyi rol don du zhen// de ni sgra yi brjod byar btags// 'khrul pa'i bag chags goms pa yis// brda yi dus na bsres nas sbyar// tha snyad dus na'ang de ltar go /de phyir 'khrul yang bden par 'thad// sgra don gzhan las ldog na ni// dngos po brjod byar 'gyur zhe na// dam pa'i don la mi ldog kyang*// ldog par snang ba 'khrul pa yin// spyi ni 'khrul par mi 'dod pas// des na de dag ga la mtshungs// rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan brjod na ni// shes pa brjod byar 'gyur zhe na// rang mtshan ldog pa brjod bya min// 'khrul pas btags pa dngos med yin// des na rtog pa'i gzugs brnyan la// 'jig rten gzhug phyir sbyar bar zad// sel ba'i spyi la brda sbyor na// ldan pa min dang mtshungs she na// don spyi gal te rdzas grub na// khyod bden 'on kyang dngos med yin// de phyir sel ba yul med ces// shes na brjod bya rjod byed med// brjod bya med na 'khrul pa gsog

/yin phyir tha snyad 'jig ce na// 'khrul pa'i sgo nas rang mtshan la// 'jug phyir tha snyad 'thad pa yin// chad byas 'brel pa go ba la// 'khrul pa'i 'brel pa mi dgos so// rang mtshan dang ni don spyi dang*// gnyis po gcig tu 'khrul pa ste// gsum po gang la chad byas kyang*// 'khrul pa med na brda mi 'byor// 'dir ni (16) rang mtshan gzugs brnyan gnyis// gcig tu 'khrul du gzhug pa'i phyir// rgan po rnams kyis brda chad byed// 'khrul nas don la 'jug par 'gyur// sgra yi dngos kyi brjod bya med// zhen pa'i brjod bya rang mtshan yin// 'brel pa 'khrul pas byas na yang*// 'jug pa'i skyes bu bslu ba med// ces bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las brjod bya dang rjod byed brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga pa'o// ༈ //dgag dang sgrub pa ji snyed pa// 'gal 'brel nyid la ltos pas na// tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dpyod pa yi// sngon du 'gal 'brel dpyad par bya// chos gnyis gcig pa mi srid cing*// gcig la 'brel pa mi srid pas// rang rang ngo bo la gnas pa'i// dngos po thams cad 'brel med yin// dngos med la yang dngos 'brel ni// yod ces blun po 'ga' zhig smra// dngos med ngo bo med pa la// 'brel pa yod na dngos por 'gyur// chos gang chos gzhan mi 'dor ba// 'brel pa rnams kyi spyi mtshan te// dngos po 'dre ba med phyir dang*// dngos med ngo bo med phyir med// bdag gcig pa la chos gnyis med// chos gnyis med la 'brel mi srid// des na byas dang mi rtag pa// don gyi steng na 'brel pa med// gal te byas dang mi rtag pa'i// ldog pa sgra la ma grub na// tshul gsum grub pa mi srid pas// don la bdag gcig 'brel zhe na// rdzas gcig don mthun ldog pa rnams// don la yod na ldog pa na// ma 'brel rtags min 'brel na yang*// rnam grangs pa 'am 'bras bur 'gyur//

(17) snga phyi min la de byung med// snga phyi yod na gang rung med// des na dngos dang dngos med la// de las byung ba'i 'brel pa med// 'gags pa dang ni skyes pa la// sbyor ba'i 'brel pa yod ce na// sbyor 'brel rtag na dngos po min// mi rtag na ni thug med 'gyur// gal te phan tshun ma ltos pa'i// me dud 'brel pa yin zhe na// rkyang pa re re mthong bas kyang*// gnyis ka'i 'brel pa nges par 'gyur// rgyu 'bras phan tshun ltos nas phan/ 'dogs phyir 'brel pa mi 'gal na// rgyu 'bras dngos po dngos med la// phan bya phan byed 'thad pa dka'// med na mi 'byung 'brel yin na// g.yas g.yon sogs kyang 'brel par 'gyur// don la med na mi 'byung ba'i// 'brel pa rdzas ldog btags pas khegs// rang gi mtshan nyid 'brel med kyang*// rgyu 'bras rigs la 'brel zhe na// rigs de rgyu 'bras nyid yin na// sngar gyi skyon las 'da' ba med// de las gzhan pa'i rigs yod na// spyi yi skabs su bkag zin to// 'dis ni ldan dang 'du ba dang*// khyad par dang ni khyad par can// byed dang phrad pa la sogs pa// 'brel par 'dod pa bkag pa yin// 'khar gzhong la ni rgya shug brten// de ni ldan pa'i 'brel zhes zer// rtag pa'i rten la mi rtag pa// 'brel pa 'phrod pa 'du zhes grags// byas dang mi rtag la sogs pa// don gcig la ni 'du zhes smra// tha dad gzhan gyis gzhan go ba// khyad par byed chos 'brel zhes 'dod// 'gags pa'i rgyu dang da ltar gyi// 'bras bu 'brel pa sbyor 'brel lo// bdag dang bya ba rnam gnyis la// byed pa'i 'brel pa yod do lo// (18) mig gis gzugs la lta ba la// phrad pa'i 'brel pa yin zhes zer// rje khol khyo shug la sogs kyang*// 'brel pa yin zhes rmongs pa smra// don la 'brel pa 'dod pa ni// gcig dang tha dad brtags pas khegs// ldan pa sogs la'ang gzhan sel gyis// sbrel na go byed yin zhe na// ldan pa can sogs gnod byed yod// gnod byed med na gnyis por 'dus// (ji ltar gnod pa yod ce na// gzhan yang grangs can 'dod pa yi// lcags gong dang ni me bzhin du// 'dres pa rnams dbyer med ce na// chos kyi grags pas bor ba yi// ngan rtog phal cher blun po len/)

/skyugs sman btang nas skyugs pa la// khyi las gzhan pa su zhig za// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// rnam rtog yul la 'jig rten gyi// tha snyad bzhin du dbye bsdu dang*// snga phyi rtog pas sbrel ba yis// 'jug yul bsgrub phyir 'brel par 'thad// byas dang mi rtag blos sbrel ba// don la grub na don 'brel yin// don la de dag ma grub na// don gyi sgrub byed min zhe na// brtags pa don la 'jug pa dang*// mi 'jug pa ste rnam pa gnyis// 'jug pas 'jug yul thob pa na// 'brel pa nyid de cig shos min// med na mi 'byung du ba la// med na de ni rgyu med 'gyur// yod na de nyid dngos po yi// 'brel pa nyid du 'gyur zhe na// don gyi du ba me med na// mi 'byung ba tsam yod mod kyang*// snga phyi bzung nas sbrel ba ni// rtog pa min pas sbrel mi nus// mtshan nyid dang ni mtshon bya dang*// spyi dang bye brag 'brel pa yang*// 'khrul pas dngos po gcig (19) nyid du// brtags pas 'grub kyi gzhan du min// gang yod de 'jig bum pa bzhin// sgra yang yod ces rang bzhin rtags// skyes pa kho na 'jig pa yin// de la 'jig byed gzhan mi dgos// 'jig pa rgyu gzhan la ltos phyir// ltos med 'di ni ma grub lo// 'jig par bya rgyu'i dngos po dang*// zhig pa dngos med gnyis ka la// 'jig pa'i sgra don 'jug mod kyi// gnyis ka la yang rgyu mi dgos// bum 'jig dngos med rgyu mi ltos// dngos na'ang rang grub rgyu ci dgos// gzhan rgyus byas pas de mi 'jig /des na 'jig pa rgyu med grub// 'jig pa dngos med rgyus byed ces// smra na ltos med shugs las grub// dngos med rgyu yis byed pa dang*// rgyu yis ci yang mi byed pa// don mtshungs dper na med pa la// lta dang blta rgyu med pa bzhin// tshogs pa tshang yang myu gu bzhin// ltos med 'di yang ma nges lo// tshogs pa de dag 'gyur ba la// ltos pa'i phyir na ma nges min// byas pa'ang dus la ltos she na// dus la ltos na byas pa de// 'gyur na 'jig pa ltos med grub// mi 'gyur sngar bzhin 'jig med gnas// tshogs pa 'gyur med gcig yin pas// gtan tshigs 'di ni ma grub lo// tshogs pas phyi nas bskyed pa ltar// gcig phyir dang po bskyed par 'gyur// gcig nyid na yang gegs yod phyir// myu gu bskyed par mi nges na// gegs can gegs med tha dad phyir// gcig tu 'dod kyang gnyis su 'gyur// nas kyi rgyu tshogs sā lu yi// myu gu bskyed la ltos mod kyang*// sā lus myu gu mi bskyed pas// gtan tshigs 'di ni ma nges lo// sā lu'i sa bon la ltos phyir// ltos

(20) med yin pa'i rtags ma grub// byas yod skad cig 'jig pa min// 'jig pa'i rgyu la ltos she na// myu gu rang rang rgyu la ltos// dngos 'jig rgyu gzhan la mi ltos// 'jig pa dngos med rgyu mi dgos// des na 'jig byed gzhan mi dgos// dngos 'gal rdzas gcig 'gyur ba dang*// de nyid gzhan du mi 'thad dang*// thogs bcas thogs med mtshungs pa yi// thal ba gsum gyis 'dir mi 'gog /bya rog dkar po srid pa ltar// dngos po rtag pa mi 'gal zer// rtags des don byed mi nus na// dngos med yin phyir don la mthun// nus de 'gyur na rtag pa nyams// 'gyur ba med na byed pa 'gal// gang gang byed min de dngos med// mkha' bzhin rtag pa'ang byed pas stong*// chos can rtag pa'i gzhan sel yin// dngos po bkag nyid bsgrub bya'i chos// phyogs chos mngon sum gyis grub zer// dgag bya 'dzin pa skye mi dgos// la la rtog myong gcig yin lo// log rtog nyid kyang mi srid 'gyur// des na skad cig gis stong la// don byed 'gog pa'i rtags kyis grub// rang bzhin rtag kyang gnas skabs rnams// 'gyur phyir don byed 'thad ce na// gnyis po gcig na chos gnyis 'gal// tha dad yin na byed pa 'gal// skad cig 'jig pa med na yang*// rags pa'i 'gyur ba yod ce na// dang po skad cig mi 'jig na// rags pa'i 'gyur ba ga la srid// don byed nus pa bkag pa la// dngos po med pas khyab pa 'grub// gnod pa can gyi lam sbyong du// ltos med 'chad pa dgongs pa min// des na log rtog rnam gnyis kyi// gnyen por gtan tshigs rnam gnyis gsungs//

(21) rgyu 'bras phrugs lngas nges zhes zer// ha cang thal phyir 'di mi 'thad// rgyu 'bras phan 'dogs bya byed yin// rgyu yang nyer len lhan cig byed// de yang rjes su 'gro ldog gi /sgo nas phrugs gsum rnam pa gnyis// mtshan nyid mi 'grub ha cang thal// gzhan du 'khrul pas 'dir mi gnod// gang dag rgyu min las skyes pa// de ni de yi 'bras bu min// rnam pa 'dra bas 'khrul pa la// de yi ming gis btags par zad// rdo dang shing sogs me rgyu min// me rgyu me yi rdul phran yin// rdul phran gcig tu sdud pa'i rgyu// rdo shing sogs yin dbang po bzhin// yang na sngon dang phyi ma yi// rgyu dang 'bras bu tha dad yod// me dang du bas bskyed pa yi// 'bras bu du ba'i khyad par bzhin// rang mtshan dang ni sgra don gnyis// 'brel pa'i mtshan gzhir mi 'thad pas// sgra yi don la rang mtshan du// 'khrul pa'i gzhan sel kho na yin// bde byed dga' ba dpyod pa yis// 'brel pa nges par byed ces grag /nyi 'og pa rnams tshad ma yis// 'brel pa nges par byed par 'dod// tshad ma'i stobs kyis bskyed pa yi// gzhan sel nges pa'i bdag nyid can// 'khrul pas dngos po gcig nyid du// rtog dpyod de yis 'brel pa nges// dngos po'i don la 'brel pa med// 'brel pa gnyis kyang sgro btags yin// sgra yi don la rang mtshan du// 'khrul pas 'brel pa'i rtog pa skye// zhes bya ba bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las 'brel pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste drug pa'o// ༈ //chos gang gang la gnod byed pa// de ni de yi 'gal zla yin// (22) 'gal zla dngos po dngos med kyi// yul gyi dbye ba la ltos nas// lhan cig mi gnas pa dag dang*// phan tshun spangs 'gal gnyis su bzhed// lhan cig mi gnas gnod byed du// 'dod pa dpyad na 'thad ma yin// des na gnod bya gnod byed gnyis// rgyu 'bras bzhin du tha dad yin// gang gis gnod bya nus med du// bskyed pa'i rgyu la gnod byed zer// lhan cig mi gnas ji snyed pa// dngos po gnod byed gnyis la 'jug

/de yang rgyun min skad cig min// bskyed bya skyed byed yin phyir ro// skad cig mi 'gal rgyun ma grub// des na 'gal 'di mi 'thad lo// skad cig snga ma snga ma las// sngon med phyi ma phyi ma skye// de la rgyun du sgro btags pa// zlog par byed la nyes pa med// rdul phran 'gal ba lhan cig tu// gnas na lhan cig mi gnas 'gal// mi gnas na ni gcig bcom pas// rgyu 'bras dus mnyam 'gyur zhe na// la la nye bar zha bar 'dod// kha cig phrad nas bsgyur bar 'dod// 'ga' zhig phrad pa med par 'dod// rtag smra de dag 'khrul pa yin// lhan cig gnas na 'gal ba nyams// bsgyur na rtag par 'dod pa 'gal// des na rdul phran las rdul phran// nus med skye phyir 'gal ba med// la la bya rdzogs skad cig gsum// 'ga' zhig yun ring 'grogs zhes zer// yun ring 'grogs pa'i lhan cig tu// mi gnas pa de ngo mtshar che// phrad dang nus med skyes pa de// skad cig gsum la don 'gal ldog /nges pa skyes pas sgro 'dogs phyis// mi skye ba ni blo yi yin// skad cig gcig la cha med na// rags pa'i rgyun rnams med par 'gyur// cha shas yod na thug (23) med pas// gsum la ldog pa dka' zhe na// skad cig la ni cha shas med// rgyun yang skad cig skyes tsam yin// rdul dang skad cig mi mtshungs pas// gsum pa nyid la ldog pa yin// grang reg nus pa thogs med des// nus can bskyed dam nus med bskyed// gnyis ka ltar yang tsha reg la// dgos nus med par 'gyur zhe na// grang reg nus pa thogs med de// skad cig gnyis pa'i nyer len yin// lhan cig byed rkyen gang dang gang*// phrad pa de yis 'bras bu 'byin// spang bya'i ngo bo'am sa bon spong*// gnyis ka ltar yang mi 'thad zer// sa bon spong ba'i gnyen po'ang yod// nges pas sgro 'dogs gnyis ka min// 'brel pa bzhin du 'gal ba yang*// dngos po'i don la grub pa med// rnam par rtog pas sgro btags nas// 'gal ba nyid du rnam par bzhag

/snang dang mi snang ma gtogs pa// 'gal ba nges byed gzhan yod min// grang reg 'gog la me tsam ni// ma nges stobs ldan mi 'grub lo// kha cig stobs ldan 'gog ces zer// rang gi ngo bo me tsam yin// chos gang chos gzhan gyis dben pa// phan tshun spangs 'gal yin zhes zer// dbye na dngos 'gal brgyud 'gal gnyis// brgyud 'gal la yang rnam gnyis 'dod// rdzas dang ldog pa 'gal ba yi// sgo nas gnyis gnyis rnam pa drug /chos gzhan dben pa 'gal yin na// 'brel pa rnams kyang 'gal bar 'gyur// 'dod na 'gal ba 'gog pa dang*// 'brel na sgrub pa'i rnam gzhag 'jig /tha dad 'brel lam ma 'brel yang*// ngo bo yin pa 'gog ce na// 'gal ba dmigs pas 'gog pa'i phyir// (24) snang rung med pa nus med 'gyur// tha dad 'gal bar gsungs pa ni// btags pa ba yin 'brel pa bzhin// rgyu dang shes pa'i dbye ba yis// tha dad tha dad min gzhag byed// tha dad phan gnod 'brel dang 'gal// gnyis ka min na tha dad tsam// rang min 'gog pa dngos 'gal yin// brgyud 'gal rang min khyab byed 'gog /sngo sogs 'gal gnyis min mi khegs// she na spangs yin 'gal ba min// phan tshun spang 'gal gcig pa bkag /de yin de ma yin gyis 'gog /phan tshun spangs pa'i dngos po gnyis// yin pa snang rung med pas khegs// bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las 'gal ba brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o// ༈ //shes bya kun la chos gsum gyis// khyab phyir de yi rnam gzhag bshad// mtshan nyid go byed don gyi chos// mtshon bya go bya blo yi chos// mtshan gzhi go bya rten gyi chos// de dag rnam par gzhag 'jog yin// chos gsum la yang rgyu mtshan dgos// med na thams cad 'chol bar 'gyur// mtshan nyid rdzas yod la mtshan nyid// mi dgos dgos na thug med zer// kha cig don la mi dgos kyang*// tha snyad la dgos gzhan dag ni// don la'ang dgos zer mtshon bya yang*// de 'dra rtags bzhin thug med zer// rnam 'jog rgyu ni ma nges par// rnam gzhag 'bras bu nges na ni// mtshan nyid dgos pa med par 'gyur// ma nges na ni thug med 'jig

/rtags kyi mtshan gzhis bsgrub bya'i don// sgrub phyir thug med skyon med na// tshul gsum lkog shal ma nges kyang*// byas (25) dang dkar zal nges tsam gyis// mi rtag ba lang rtogs par 'gyur// tha snyad la yang zhen rung zhig /med na de ni shes bya min// yod na de nyid phyi ma yi// mtshan nyid yin zhes la la 'dod// de lta yin na yal ga la'ang*// yal ga med na shing ma yin// yal ga yod na shing la yang*// mtshan nyid thug pa med par 'gyur// yal ga la ni yal ga gzhan// med kyang yal ga de nyid kyis// tsan+dan ngo bo dbyer med du// bsgrub phyir thug med mi dgos na// tha snyad gnyis pa med na yang*// tha snyad de nyid mtshan nyid kyis// shes bya'i ngo bor sgrub pa'i phyir// tha snyad thug med ga la dgos// brda don 'brel par nam rtogs pa// de yi tshe na tha snyad grub// rtags dang mtshan nyid gnyis ka la// spyi dang bye brag gnyis gnyis yin// gnyis ka'ang sbyor ba gsum par thug /bzhi pa phan chad dgos nus med// tshul gsum tshul gsum med na rtags// mi 'gyur yod na thug med lo// tshul gsum du ba kho na'i chos// dbyer med yin gyis chos gzhan med// 'di yi mtshan nyid thug med du// thal ba'i skyon yang bsal ba yin// la la mtshon bya rnam 'jog zer// gtan tshigs la yang mtshungs phyir min// 'ga' zhig chos gsum tshang bar 'dod// mtshon bya ltos phyir 'di mi 'thad// dngos 'gal gcod pa'i don ldog yin// mtshan nyid de yi skyon bsdu na// gsum zhes byang phyogs pa rnams 'dod// sbyor ba bkod nas skyon brtsi na// don ldog gzhan 'gyur med par 'gyur// ma bkod pa la skyon sbyor na// mtshan gzhi mi gnas don med 'gyur// 'di dag skyon du 'thad na ni// (26) mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan cis mi bzhed// ma khyab khyab ches mi srid gsum// mtshan nyid kyi ni spyi skyon yin// sgra dang don gyi rnam gcod kun// gsum po 'di las gzhan yod min// mtshan gzhir bkod dang ma bkod dang*// mtshan nyid mi srid pa yi gzhir// mtshon bya khegs dang mi khegs zhes// rtsod pa gnyis kyis 'dir mi gnod// kha cig mtshan mtshon rdzas gcig zer// tha snyad mtshon bya'i mtshan gzhir 'dod// mtshon bya ming gis khyad par du// byas phyir mtshan nyid mthong ba yi// dbang shes rtog bcas nyid 'gyur zhing*// don grub rdzas yod dag tu'ang 'gyur// brda la 'jug pa tha snyad du// gsungs phyir mtshon bya'i mtshan gzhi min// rgyu mtshan can gyi sgra shes ni// mtshon bya nyid yin de yi gzhi// rgyu mtshan nyid la brda sbyar ba'o// de ltar rtogs nas sgo gsum ni// 'jug pa de yi tha snyad yin// don la ltos pa'i ming yin pas// btags yod nyid yin dngos po la// ma grub phyir na sgro btags yin// mtshan mtshon rdzas gcig ma yin na// rang bzhin rtags su mi 'thad lo// sgra yi don la gcig nyid du// 'khrul pas tha snyad sbyor ba ni// 'jig rten don la mi slu'i phyir// grags pa'i rjes dpag ga la 'gal// mtshan nyid brten pa mtshan gzhi yin// mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa gnyis// 'ga' zhig chos gsum rang ldog ni// rang gi rnam pa 'char rung zer// de lta yin na chos gsum po// rtog med yul du thal bar 'gyur// des na snang ba'i ldog pa ni// chos gsum nyid min sel ba yi// chos gsum gyi ni rang ldog la// sgrub dang dgag

(27) pa gnyis ka yod// mtshan mtshon rang bzhin 'brel pa yin// mtshan gzhi phal cher gnas skabs 'brel// 'khrul pas gcig tu 'dzin pa nyid// myong bas mtshan mtshon 'brel pa 'grub// mtshan gzhi dang ni mtshon bya yi// 'brel pa mkhas pas mthong bas dran// rmongs pa la ni brda dran pa'i// tha snyad sgrub kyi rjes dpag dgos// gsum po de la spyi dang ni// sbyor ba 'dir gtogs gnyis gnyis drug /bzlog la'ang drug las mtshan nyid dang*// mtshan gzhi'i cha gnyis skyon med srid// sbyor ba 'dir gtogs mtshan nyid de// gzhi mtshon gnyis la khegs na ni// mtshan gzhi lkog shal khegs par 'gyur// ma khegs na ni khyab ches zer// don ldog la khyab rang ldog la// ma khyab pas na nyes pa med// mtshon bya 'gal dang tha snyad khegs// dngos 'gal gzhi mtshon rtsod pa med// des na la lar 'gal ba dang*// mtshungs par mngon pa'i sbyor ba srid// mtshan mtshon grangs mnyam ngo bo gcig /rdzas yod btags yod nyid du nges// mtshan mtshon don la gcig pa dang*// tha dad grangs mi mnyam pa 'khrul// de dag phan tshun bzlog pa yi// rnam par gzhag pas 'dir mi gnod// mi slu ma shes don gsal gnyis// rnam grangs pa 'am phye ste smra// mtshan nyid gnyis kyis 'jog na ni// mtshon bya de yang gnyis su 'gyur// mtshan mtshon gnyis su 'dod na yang*// spyi mtshan gcig pa mi srid 'gyur// ma khyab gcod tshul 'dir mi 'thad// gnyis su 'byed pa dgongs pa min// mi dgos ma khyab mi srid gsum// bden pa'i don rtogs 'dod na yod// mi slu ma shes (28) don gsal gnyis// rang mtshan rtogs par don la mthun// tha snyad pa dang don dam pa// gnyis ka la yang gnyis po 'jug /mi slu las dang byed po dang*// bya ba gsum gyi bdag nyid can// dngos med 'jal la ma khyab cing*// nye bar bslad la khyab ches lo// rang mtshan yod med dpyod phyir 'thad// nye bar bslad pa bslu bar bshad// tshad ma'i stobs kyis nges pa 'dren// nges pa'i 'gal zla sgro 'dogs yin// de yi mtshan nyid gnas lugs las// mtha' gzhan du rtog dbye na gnyis// rtog pa log shes the tshom mo// ma rtogs pa las glo bur du// rtogs pas sgro 'dogs ma bcad lo// rjes dpag snang bas mi 'jug pas// sel ba nyid yin de yi yul// me med gzhan dang mtshungs pa ru// 'dzin phyir log shes yin par bzhed// nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs gnyis// yul dang ngo bo dus gsum la// gcig dang tha dad brtags pa yi// rtsod pa gsum gyis 'dir mi gnod// nges dang sgro 'dogs zhen yul gcig

/zhen stangs tha dad phyir na sel// tshad ma min la yang dag bkag /yang dag phye nas 'chad pa 'khrul// des na yang dag shes pa nyid// tshad ma yin phyir dbye gzhir 'thad// dbye na mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis// de dag gcig dang tha dad brtag /tshad ma gnyis ka dngos po nyid// yin phyir gcig pa bkag pa min// yul gcig pa dang tha dad la// ltos nas gcig dang tha dad min// des na blo yi ngo bor gcig /yul la ltos nas tha dad yin// rjes dpag yul min rang rig dang*// gcig phyir brtsad pa'i skyon las grol// gzhal (29) bya gnyis phyir tshad ma gnyis// de las grangs gzhan bkag phyir ro// ming la bshad 'jug rnam pa gnyis// de la bshad 'jug 'gal ba dang*// mi 'gal 'gal zhing mi 'gal ba'i// rnam par dbye ba rnam pa bzhi// de dag ming dang rigs kyi sgra// mkhas pa rnams kyis gnyis su phye// yul dus rnam pa 'khrul pa'i cha// mngon sum tshad mar 'dod pa yod// rang mtshan med phyir mngon sum min// rtags las nges na rjes dpag srid// kha dog 'dzin pa reg bya la// mngon sum yin zhes la la smra// skye mched rnam dbye ma shes pas// rgyu chos mngon sum yin par 'khrul// rtog pa yul dus rnam pa la// 'khrul pas mngon sum 'gog ces zer// rtog pa 'khrul yang dbang shes la// mi sgrib sngo 'dzin tshad ma bzhin// 'ga' zhig yin min mtshungs zhes zer// mtshungs min yul tha dad phyir ro// nor bu'i 'od las nor bu nyid// rtogs pa rjes dpag min zhe na// sā lu'i myu gus sā lu sogs// 'bras rtags phal cher 'khrul par 'gyur// rtags dang bsgrub bya 'khrul na yang*// don dang cha la tshad ma zer// de lta'i rtags la tshul gsum med// grub la rtags kyi khyad par med// tshad ma de dag nges pa ni// rang gzhan gang las rtogs she na// la la rang las nges par 'dod// 'ga' zhig gzhan las nges zhes zer// de dag gnyis kas rigs pa dang*// rigs pa smra ba'i bzhed pa dor// don rig gnyis dang rang rig dang*// rjes su dpag pa rang las nges// dang po pa dang yid ma gtad// 'khrul rgyu can rnams gzhan las nges// don byed pa dang goms pa can// rjes su

(30) dpag pas nges par byed// kha cig yul dang ngo bo la// brtags nas gzhan nges mi srid zer// de dag gis ni mngon sum dang*// rtog pa'i byed pa 'dres par zad// snang ba dngos po'i yul can yin// sel ba la ni dgag sgrub gnyis// dgag pa sgrub pa spong ba dang*// mi spong ba yi sgo nas gnyis// kha cig dngos shugs sgo nas kyang*// sgrub pa dang ni 'gog ces zer// rjes dpag shugs rtogs nyid du 'gyur// min na tshad ma gsum par 'gyur// don dang shes pa yin pa dang*// yod pa'i dbye bas gnyis gnyis bzhi// dgag pa de nyid bzlog pa bzhi// dgag sgrub de yang tshad mas 'grub// shugs las rtogs zhes gsungs pa yang*// byed pa'am rjes dpag nyid la dgongs// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las mtshan nyid brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pa'o// ༈ //myong bas sgro 'dogs gcod pa 'khrul// mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul ba// rtog pa sgra don 'dzin pa yin// ma 'khrul pa de rnam pa bzhi// yul dang rten dang gang zag gi /sgo nas mngon sum rnam par dbye// mngon sum bzhi po mdo sde'i lugs// bye brag smra gsum rnam rig gnyis// phye nas mtshan nyid 'jog pa 'khrul// des na dbang shes ma 'khrul pa'o// dbang po yul la 'dzin nus te// rjes su 'gro ldog nges pas 'grub// gsal bar snang bas rtog med 'grub// rang mtshan 'dzin phyir 'khrul pa med// dbang po thun mong min rgyu'i phyir// dbang shes yin te rnga sgra bzhin// yul dang dbang shes rnam gnyis kyi// de ma thag las skyes pa yid// de la brten nas ma 'khrul pa'i// shes pa

(31) yid kyi mngon sum yin// yid kyi mngon sum du ma yang*// dbang shes bzhin du rang rig gcig /'khrul pa med phyir tshad ma yin// rgyun med phyir na nges mi nus// dbang po gzugs can las dbang skye// des na dbang shes rgyun bcas yin// yid dbang las ni yid dbang min// de yi phyir na de rgyun med// spel ma dang ni rgyun gyi mtha'// gnyis ka la yang gnod byed yod// des na dbang po dbang shes kyi// rgyu yin yid kyi rkyen du 'gyur// rang rig yin phyir rgyud gzhan med// des na mngon sum 'gros gsum pa// yul gzhan 'dzin dang dbang po la// ltos phyir 'di la skyon gnyis med// rang gi ngo bo rig pa ni// mngon sum yin par mkhas rnams bzhed// rang skye sngon med skye ba yin// rang rig bem po bzlog tsam yin// des na rang rig rang skye gnyis// mtshungs pa'i go skabs yod ma yin// phye nas mtshan nyid 'jog par 'khrul// bsgom byung 'khrul med mngon sum ste// 'khrul pa can rnams ltar snang yin// 'phags pa gsum gyi mngon sum gsum// slob dang mi slob sgo nas lnga// de dag snang bcas snang med kyi// dbye bas gnyis gnyis rnam pa bcu// thabs dang shes rab legs sbyangs pa// phan tshun rgyu dang rkyen gyur pas// ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i// ye shes gzigs pa 'grub par 'gyur// tshe gsum bskal pa brgya dang ni// grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin// thabs zhan pas na rnam grol gnyis// bag chags bcas phyir ston pa min// thabs la goms pas dngos kun gsal// bag chags spangs phyir kun mkhyen yin// bcad shes dang ni nges pa (32) gnyis// rtog pa yin phyir mngon sum min// des na rnal 'byor mngon sum kun// mngon sum yin phyir tshad mar grub// so so skye bo'i tshad ma ni// nges pa nyid las 'jug ldog byed// 'phags pa rtog pa bral ba rnams// ting nge 'dzin las byed par gsungs// bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes can// de yi mkhyen pa dpag mi nus// tshig gi khyad par nges gyur na// sngon byung ba yang dpag par nus// goms pa rdzogs nas de gsal ba// mtha' gzhan bkag pa'i nges pas 'grub// 'di la kha cig rten brten pa// rig pa'i thog mtha' rnam pa gnyis// me dang sgron ma dper byas nas// mngon sum nyid kyis 'grub ces zer// thug med rang rig gis mi 'grub// me dang sgron ma dper mi rung*// sems las gzhan la ltos med kyi// rtags kyis sngon mtha' thug med 'grub// rgyu tshogs tshang zhing gegs med pa'i// rtags kyis phyi mtha' thug med 'grub// las dang lus sems 'khor ba'i rgyu// gnyis po spang phyir dka' spyod zer// mi nus mi phan mi dgos pas// las dang lus 'dzad lam ma yin// skye rgyu ma rig de las kyang*// nyon mongs las dang 'khor ba 'byung*// skye mched 'di las skye mched gzhan// de yi bzang ngan las kyis byed// byams sogs bdag dang mi 'gal phyir// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod nus min// bdag med bdag dang 'gal bas na// bdag med mthong bas de sun 'byin// sa bon thog ma yod min yang*// mes bsregs pa na phyi mtha' mthong*// de bzhin 'khor ba thog med kyang*// bdag med mthong na phyi mtha' 'grub// gsal ba bskyed la rgyu tshang zhing*// gegs med phyir na bskyed par nges// 'jig sogs

(33) goms las gsal snang dang*// gzung 'dzin med phyir 'khrul med 'grub// mi nus mi shes mi brtan phyir// spangs pa'i grol ba med ce na// rang bzhin min phyir thabs yod phyir// rgyu spong phyir na rnam grol 'thad// mchongs dang chu dang gser gyi dpes// goms pa srid pa min zhe na// 'bad la ltos phyir mi brtan phyir// slar 'byung bskyed phyir dper mi rung*// stong nyid snying rje goms pa las// de yi ngang du 'gyur srid mod// shes bya kun la mtha' med phyir// kun mkhyen bsgrub pa dka' zhes zer// gtso bo'i don la mi slu ba// kun mkhyen yin te kun tshogs bzhin// dgos pa'i don kun shes pa la// mkhas rnams thams cad mkhyen zhes zer// thams cad 'dus nas nyan pa la// ba lang med kyang skyon ma yin// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad do// yang na rjes su dpag pa yis// thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa yin// bskal pa'i bar du brjod rgyu yang*// me long nang du cig char 'char// de bzhin shes bya mtha' med pa// mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis mkhyen// bar skabs su tshigs su bcad pa'o// 'khrul pa'i shes pa thams cad ni// mngon sum ltar snang nyid du 'dod// de la rtog pa rtog med gnyis// rtog med la yang yid dbang gnyis// rtog pa gsum yin drug bshad pa// log rtog bzlog phyir phye ste gsungs// lta dang nges pa tshad 'bras dang*// phrad dang don rtogs tshad 'bras 'dod// khyad par khyad par can der smra// la la dbang shes tshad 'bras 'dod// des na rnam par gzhag 'jog gi /rgyu 'bras (34) nyid la tshad 'bras bzhed// de la rang rig tshad 'bras ni// rnam gzhag grub mtha' phal cher mthun// don rig smra ba rang rang gi /grub mtha'i stobs kyis tshad 'bras 'jog /me yi rang mtshan gzhal bya la// du ba las byung gzhan sel blo// tshad ma nyid yin de rtogs pa// 'bras bu yin zhes mkhas rnams bzhed// me snang bag chags snying po las// du bar snang ba'i bag chags skye// des na skyes bu mi slu ba// rjes dpag yin zhes mkhas rnams bzhed// tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las mngon sum brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa ste dgu pa'o//

༈ //rjes dpag rnam gnyis rang don ni// tshul gsum rtags las don mthong yin// phyogs ni chos dang chos can gyi// tshogs pa brjod la dngos ming yin// de yi phyogs res zin pa'i phyir// ya gyal gnyis la btags nas 'jug /brjod par 'dod pas sngon sbyar ba// de nyid go ba dngos ming yin// de brten rgyu mtshan 'ga' las gzhan// rtog pas btags pa ming du 'dod// tshogs don la ni phyogs kyi sgra// mkhas pa rnams la gdod nas grub// btags pa la ni 'dra ba dang*// 'brel pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan la ltos// chos la bsgrub byar ming btags pa// 'gal ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag tu// log par rtog pa spang phyir ram// sdeb sbyor ngor byas btags pa yin// chos can brjod na 'khrul gzhi yod// mtha' rnams bkag na yun ring 'gor// dngos ming brjod na sdeb sbyor nyams// bde blag rtogs phyir phyogs zhes gsungs// phyogs dang chos can mtshungs she na// grags pa'i sgo nas khyad par yod// chos (35) dang 'brel pa'i phyogs kyi sgra// rtsod gzhi nyid yin lag ldan bzhin// chos dang 'brel yang chos can sgras// nges par mi nus mgo ldan bzhin// bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// chos dang chos can bsgrub bya nyid// ma yin mtshan nyid med phyir ro// dpag gzhir bzung ba shes 'dod yin// de la grub pa phyogs chos so// bsgrub bya'i chos ldan mi ldan la// mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs zhes zer// phyogs gnyis dngos 'gal du bsams nas// phung gsum byung bar dogs pa la// tshad ma'i yul mi shes pa 'ga'// rdzas ldog rnam par phye ste smra// rdzas chos gcig dang tha dad ldan// ldog chos rang ldog rten zhes zer// rdzas ldog ji ltar phye na yang*// phyogs gnyis nyid du nges mi nus// gnyis la 'jug pa'i rdzas ldog kyang*// mkhas pa rnams la grub par mthong*// don la dgag sgrub byed na ni// tshad ma'i yul mi shes par 'gyur// blo ngor dgag sgrub byed na ni// yod med ma nges gsum du 'gyur// shes 'dod phyogs su mi 'dod phyir// ltos gzhi dang po med par 'gyur// ltos gzhi dang po mi 'dod na// 'di la phyogs chos mtshan nyid dka'// ltos gzhi dang po phyogs gnyis su// nges na ltos gzhi gzhan gnyis kyi// yod med nges pa'i 'gro ldog kyang*// brjod pa rab tu dka' ba yin// phyogs chos dang ni phyogs gnyis po// gcig la ldog pas 'byed na ni// rtags kun phyogs su lhung 'gyur bas// gtan tshigs ma nges ga la srid/

(/tshogs don mthun phyogs nyid yin na// de yi yan lag de ldan nyid/) /shes bya phyogs gnyis nges pa dang*// (36) ltos gzhi gsum du 'dod pa 'gal// ltos gzhi gnyis su 'dod na ni// de ltos rtags kyang tshul gnyis 'gyur// mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gnyis su// nges pa slob dpon mi bzhed do// rdzas ldog so sor phye ba yis// rjes su 'jug na tha snyad 'jig /rang ldog brten nas sgrub pa yi// tshul 'di brtags na snying po med// phyogs gnyis dngos 'gal ma yin phyir// dgag sgrub rnam gzhag 'jig ce na// dgag sgrub phyogs kyis byed pa min// tshad ma'i 'gal 'brel nges pas 'grub// rtags dang bsgrub bya 'brel stobs kyis// yod med nges pa rjes 'gro ldog /phyogs dang bsgrub bya'i chos kyi spyis// mtshungs dang mi mtshungs phyogs gnyis yin// mthun yul phyogs kyang btags pa bas// gzhan sel nyid yin gnyis po min// 'di la gzhan gyi klan ka med// gzhung gi dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid yin// rdzas ni dngos po las gzhan min// gzhan sel las gzhan ldog pa med// des na rdzas ldog gcig nyid du// 'khrul pa nyid la dgag sgrub byed// yod med gnyis ka la brten nas// sgra don gsum gyis chos gnyis sgrub// du ba'i rtags las skya bo'i rdzas// tshul gsum rtags la shes bya tsam// mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gnyis su// dpyad na tshad ma 'jig ce na// du ba dang ni tshul gsum gyi// gzhan sel gnyis po skya bo dang*// shes bya gnyis kyi log pa dang*// ldog pa gnyis la 'brel phyir 'thad// ldog 'gog chos rtags phyogs gnyis kyi// rtsod pa bzhi yi gzhan lan 'khrul// med dgag tha snyad med dgag dang*// spyi ldog phung gsum yin phyir 'thad// ji snyed rtags su bkod gyur pa// (37) de snyed phyogs gsum la ltos pas// dngos su gang rung ma tshang yang*// ltos gzhi nyid du 'dod pa yin// dgag sgrub sel bas byed 'di la// rdzas ldog phye nas phyogs gnyis su// rtsod pa'i nyes pas mi gnod de// tshad ma'i yul la mkhas phyir ro// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// tshul gcig nas ni drug gi bar// nyi tshe'i tshul gzhan 'dod pa 'khrul// phyogs chos grub cing 'brel pa nges// gtan tshigs mtshan nyid skyon med yin/

(/phyogs chos grub pa tshul dang po/) /tshul gnyis pa dang rjes 'gro yis// ldog pa 'phen pa'i skyon gnyis med// nges rung rtags min the tshom phyir// nges pa rtags yin go byed phyir// 'di la gzhan gyi klan ka med// kha cig rtsod gzhis khyad par du// byas pa rtags kyi mtshan gzhir 'dod// mi ldan gcod pa rtsod gzhi yis// yin na yu bu rtsod pa med// gzhan ldan gcod na rjes 'gro med// bsgrub bya'i chos kyang de dang 'dra// rtags kyi mtshan gzhi gzhan sel yin// 'di la gzhan gyi klan ka med// mtshan nyid de dang ldan pa yi// gtan tshigs dbye sgos du mar 'gyur// chos kyi grags pas sbyor ba yi// sgo nas gsum du nges par mdzad// dgag bya 'gog la tshul gsum tshang*// ngo bo mi dmigs pa la bzhi// 'gal ba dmigs pa rnam pa gnyis// tsha reg skor bzhis grang reg bzhi// bkag pas sbyor ba bcu drug zer// nus pa thogs med me min zhing*// rgyun med phyir na 'gog mi nus// gzhung las rnam gzhag mang bshad kyang*// 'gog nus snga ma bcu gnyis yin// phan tshun spangs pa dngos la ni// rtags dang rtags can yod (38) ma yin// de yi khyad par byas pa ni// khyab byed 'gal ba dmigs pa yin// tshad mas gnod pa'i 'gal ba yang*// khyab byed 'gal ba dmigs par 'dus// dngos 'brel bkag zin lhan cig na// mi gnas tshogs pas bskyed pa 'khrul// 'brel yul log pas 'brel chos nyid// ldog pas bzlog 'brel blo ngor grub// yin pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang*// ngo bo dbyer med rang bzhin rtags// de yi cha mthun khongs su bsdu// gcig phyir tha dad skyon mi 'go /yod pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang*// de byung ba la 'bras bu'i rtags// de dang cha mthun khongs su bsdu// tha dad sgrub phyir skyon las grol// kha cig 'brel ba mu dgu la// go byed 'brel ba bzhi yod lo// 'di ni rnam gzhag 'gal ba dang*// gzhung gi dgongs par 'thad ma yin// khyad par bya byed 'brel ba yi// stobs kyis bsgrub bya go ba min// de yi ngo bo'am don gzhan gyi// 'brel ba'i stobs kyis rtogs par zad// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// rtags gang tshul gsum ma grub pa// phyogs la rtags med ma grub pa// phyogs chos don nam blo ngo la// mi gnas ma grub pa nyid yin// phyogs re'am rgol ba rnam gnyis la// ma grub rnam par phye ste bshad// bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// ma nges the tshom bskyed pa'i rtags// phyogs min gzhan la ma grub pa// thun mong ma yin dbye na bzhi// phyogs las gzhan 'jug thun mong ba// dbye na dngos dang lhag ldan gnyis// gnyis ka la mthong bzlog mi chod// yang dag lhag ldan mthun phyogs mthong*// mi mthun phyogs la ma mthong

(39) ba'o// mi mthun phyogs mthong mthun phyogs la// ma mthong 'gal ba'i lhag ldan yin// rtags grub bzlog pas khyab na 'gal// mi dmigs rang bzhin gtan tshigs su// bsdus pas 'gal ba gnyis nyid yin// btsal ma thag byung mi rtag 'bras// rtag la 'gyur ba med phyir 'gal// mi rtag 'gyur phyir 'di mi mtshungs// de 'dra 'gyur med la mi 'thad// mi dmigs gsum par 'byed na ni// de bzlog 'gal ba'ang gsum du 'gyur// 'ga' zhig chos dang chos can gyi// dbye bas 'gal ba bzhi zhes zer// dngos shugs chos dang chos can gyi// 'gal ba brjod 'dod stobs kyis yin// yang dag la yang mtshungs she na// byed pa chung phyir btang snyoms mdzad// zhe 'dod dang ni smras pa gnyis// bsgrub bya nyid du mtshungs pa'i phyir// gzhan don sgrub pa'i 'gal ba sogs// 'gal ba gsum pa 'dir mi bzhed// mtha' gzhan 'gog pa'i nges pa yis// rtags su bkod pa bzhi ru nges// rtags su bkod pa bzhi po la// nus pa de yang rnam bzhi yod// mdo las mtshan nyid lnga ldan gsungs// bsgrub byar 'dod pa rigs pa'i sgor// 'di la ma khyab khyab ches dang*// rtags la mtshungs pa'i rtsod pa med// bsgrub bya mtshan gzhi dngos po'am// btags par phye ste sgrub pa 'khrul// sgra yi don la rang mtshan du// 'khrul pa bsgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi yin// 'di la dngos po dngos med du// sgrub la rtsod pa'i go skabs med// bsal ba phyogs dang 'gal ba grub// lnga po bzhi ru bsdus te bshad// yul gyi sgo nas rjes dpag la// phye ste bsal ba bzhi ru gsungs// mngon sum rjes (40) dpag dngos stobs kyi// tshad yin khas blangs grags pa gnyis// sgro btags yin phyir khongs su sdud// rjes dpag bzhin du mngon sum la'ang*// bsal ba gnyis po 'jug ce na// khas blangs 'bras rtags las gzhan min// rung ba mngon sum gyis mi 'grub// dam bcas nyid nas myong ba dang*// 'gal ba mngon sum bsal ba yin// tshul gsum dngos po stobs zhugs dang*// dam bcas 'gal na rtags bsal yin// yid ches tshig dang dam bcas pa// 'gal ba khas blangs bsal ba yin// de la khas blangs rang tshig gnyis// gzhan dag lung dang rang tshig zer// slob dpon ngag gi dbye bar bzhed// kun las btus su gnyis ka yang*// dpe gcig gis bstan rigs pa'i sgor// lung la dper brjod gzhan du gsungs// gzhal bya gnyis la tshad ma gnyis// bskal pa'i don la rang tshig gis// mi gnod gsung rab nged kyi lung*// rjes su dpag par bsdus te gsungs// des na rigs pas grub pa'i lung*// tshad ma nyid yin ma grub na// rang gi tshig dang mtshungs pa'i phyir// gegs byed nyid du bzhed pa yin// lung du grags tshad tshad ma min// tshad mas grub pa de lung yin// khas blangs nas ni dpyod pa blun// dpyad nas khas len mdzangs pa'i lugs// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad do// lung gzhan 'gal ba'ang der 'gyur lo// chags sogs chos
